publicrecords/sports-odds-api: Use when you need current pre-match or live prices for a game or league from Kambi-powered books (BetRivers, Unibet, Paf, Svenska Spel, ATG) and want to compare books or find the best price per outcome. Not for DraftKings/FanDuel or historical odds.
scrapemint/sports-odds-scraper: Use when you need DraftKings, Pinnacle or Bovada moneyline, spread and total lines for US leagues, UFC or soccer, side by side with the best price per outcome.
zen-studio/prizepicks-player-props: Use when the question is about player prop lines (over/under) on PrizePicks for a league, team or player.
sports-odds-lab/football-odds-results: Use for soccer odds history, opening and closing lines, results and match stats (xG, shots, corners) going back to 2005, e.g. backtesting or closing-line value.
hgservices/apify-actor-espn: Use when you need scores, schedules or final results for NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, MLS, EPL, NCAA and other leagues, or a team's next game.
constructive_calm/understat-football-ana: Use for expected goals (xG), shot maps, PPDA and player or team season stats in the Big 5 European leagues and RFPL.
jungle_synthesizer/equibase-us-horse-rac: Use for US Thoroughbred race entries and results (horses, jockeys, trainers, morning-line odds, finish order, payouts) for a date and track.
congism/polymarket-kalshi-arb-finder: Use when looking for price gaps between matching Polymarket and Kalshi binary markets.
